content.short: Blockchain at Berkeley provides focused on blockchain education, consulting, and research.
content.description: Blockchain at Berkeley is a student-led organization that provides education, consulting, and research services to students at UC Berkeley as well as to external organizations interested in blockchain technology. The group works to bridge academia and industry by offering hands-on workshops, structured courses, and tailored consulting on blockchain topics. Through these programs, Blockchain at Berkeley helps students and partner organizations understand the potential of blockchain technology and explore practical ways it can be leveraged across a wide range of industries.
